'''New Alderaan''' was a planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]]. It was home to thousands of former residents of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that moved there after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==History==
The planet was governed by the [[Alderaan Alliance]], presumably headed by the [[Alderaanian Council]].

It was established by the [[Support Services/Legends|Alliance Support Services]], including Lieutenant [[Deeve]],<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> founded by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the period [[0 BBY/Legends|preceding]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] Syndicate created a scam company called [[New Planet Motors]], a fake [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] company to steal money from [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] citizens.<ref name="air" />

[[File:Battle_of_New_Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)|battle of New Alderaan]].]]

The planet's location was known only to a select few top-level New Republic leaders, making it a perfect [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]]. Despite their efforts, the world was [[Battle of New Alderaan (Hunt for Zsinj)|devastated]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> and later the forces of the [[Essence transfer|revived]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="DEII 6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref> The New Republic reclaimed the planet after Palpatine's [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lieda Mothma]] recovered on New Alderaan from an unspecified injury or sickness.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] retired on New Alderaan, where he died of old age in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
